phrases.definition: To go eat some food together casually.
phrases.example: Let's grab a bite before the movie starts. (Đi ăn chút gì đó trước khi phim bắt đầu nhé.)

phrases.definition: A casual way to say goodbye.
phrases.example: I have to run now, catch you later! (Gặp lại bạn sau nhé!)

phrases.definition: It's not a problem; don't worry about it.
phrases.example: Thanks for the help! - No worries! (Không có gì phải lo đâu!)

phrases.definition: An informal way to admit a mistake.
phrases.example: I forgot to save the document, my bad. (Tôi quên lưu tài liệu, lỗi của tôi.)

phrases.phrase: You've got to be kidding me
phrases.example: He resigned? You've got to be kidding me! (Bạn đang đùa tôi à!)
The report isn't done, but I'm working on it. (Tôi đang làm rồi.)
Meet at 5 PM? Sounds good to me. (Nghe được đấy.)
I have my passport, so I'm all set. (Tôi đã sẵn sàng hết.)

phrases.definition: A polite way to ask for help.
phrases.example: This box is heavy, could you give me a hand? (Giúp tôi một tay được không?)
Want to go to the beach? - I'm down for that! (Tôi duyệt luôn!)
We lost the contract. Well, it is what it is. (Đành chấp nhận vậy.)

phrases.definition: Telling someone to relax or saying goodbye.
phrases.example: Have a great weekend! Take it easy! (Thư giãn đi!)
The English test was a piece of cake. (Dễ như ăn bánh.)

phrases.definition: When someone appears just after being mentioned.
phrases.example: Speak of the devil! We were just talking about you. (Vừa nhắc tào tháo xong!)
Hang on a second, I forgot my keys. (Chờ một chút.)

phrases.definition: Expressing disbelief or asking for leniency.
phrases.example: You want me to work Sunday? Give me a break! (Tha cho tôi đi!)
Where is John? - I have no idea. (Tôi hoàn toàn không biết.)
Ah, now that you explain it, that makes sense. (Nghe hợp lý đấy.)

phrases.definition: A polite way to say no or disagree slightly.
phrases.example: Are you tired? - Not really. (Cũng không hẳn.)
More coffee? - I'm good, thanks. (Tôi đủ rồi, cảm ơn.)

phrases.definition: Deciding to buy or accept something.
phrases.example: This jacket fits perfectly. I'll take it. (Tôi sẽ lấy nó.)
Join our party? - I'd love to! (Tôi rất vinh hạnh!)
He won the lottery? No way! (Không thể nào!)
This project is stressful. - You're telling me! (Chuẩn luôn!)
Meet at 9. - Sounds like a plan! (Chốt thế đi!)
Did you hear his joke? That's a good one! (Hay đấy!)
I'm not sure if the store is open. (Tôi không chắc.)
I'm leaving this company, for real. (Thật đấy.)

phrases.phrase: I'll see what I can do
phrases.example: Get me a discount? - I'll see what I can do. (Để tôi xem có thể làm gì.)
I got promoted! - Good for you! (Chúc mừng bạn!)
How does this work? - I have no clue. (Tôi chịu chết.)
We won! I can't believe it! (Không thể tin được!)
She missed the flight. - That's a shame. (Thật đáng tiếc.)

phrases.definition: Something is minor and not worth worrying about.
phrases.example: Don't worry, it's not a big deal. (Không có gì to tát đâu.)
I can't wait. I'm looking forward to it. (Tôi rất mong chờ.)

phrases.definition: Worth trying, even if it might fail.
phrases.example: It's risky, but it's worth a shot. (Đáng để thử.)
You did an amazing job, I mean it. (Tôi nói thật lòng đấy.)
It's late, I'd better get going. (Tôi nên đi thôi.)
The weather is beautiful. - I know, right? (Đúng thế chứ lị?)
This is delicious. - You can say that again! (Bạn nói quá chuẩn!)
Watch a horror movie? - I'd rather not. (Tôi không muốn lắm.)
I'm telling you, this is the best deal. (Tôi nói thật cho bạn biết đấy.)
We lost, but that's how it goes. (Cuộc sống là thế mà.)

phrases.definition: An informal way to say you cannot do something.
phrases.example: Lend me $50? - Sorry, no can do. (Không được rồi.)

phrases.definition: Meeting unexpectedly in an unlikely place.
phrases.example: Running into you here! It's a small world. (Thế giới nhỏ bé thật.)

phrases.definition: Clarifying an action was an accident.
phrases.example: I didn't mean to break your cup. (Tôi không cố ý.)
We are talking about quality, color is beside the point. (Không liên quan.)
Tell me your idea, I'm all ears. (Tôi đang toàn tâm lắng nghe đây.)
Good luck, let's keep in touch! (Giữ liên lạc nhé!)
I have an exam tomorrow, need to hit the books. (Tôi phải cày sách đây.)
I'm exhausted, I'm hitting the sack. (Tôi đi ngủ đây.)
Okay, you twisted my arm, I'll go. (Bạn thuyết phục được tôi rồi.)

phrases.definition: To contribute to a group effort.
phrases.example: If we all pitch in, it'll be fast. (Nếu cùng góp sức, sẽ nhanh thôi.)
You made a mistake, time to face the music. (Đối mặt hậu quả thôi.)
That name rings a bell. (Cái tên đó nghe quen quen.)
I go running to blow off steam. (Tôi chạy bộ để xả stress.)
She is really on the ball today. (Cô ấy rất nhạy bén.)
As a rule of thumb, always double-check. (Nguyên tắc chung là hãy kiểm tra kép.)
Keep your chin up, things will get better. (Lạc quan lên nhé.)

phrases.definition: Become confident in a new situation.
phrases.example: I'm still finding my feet at this new job. (Tôi vẫn đang làm quen.)
I'm a bit under the weather today. (Hôm nay tôi hơi không khỏe.)
Come on, spill the beans about the surprise! (Khai bí mật ra đi!)
I have to bite the bullet and pay the fine. (Phải cắn răng mà nộp phạt thôi.)

phrases.definition: Stop an activity for the rest of the night.
phrases.example: We've worked enough, let's call it a night. (Tối nay nghỉ ở đây thôi.)

phrases.definition: Do something poorly to save time/money.
phrases.example: Don't cut corners on software security. (Đừng đốt cháy giai đoạn về bảo mật.)
The argument got out of hand quickly. (Cuộc cãi vã vượt quá tầm kiểm soát.)
Buy the stock now or you'll miss the boat. (Sẽ lỡ cơ hội nếu không mua giờ.)
Are you serious or just pulling my leg? (Bạn đang đùa tôi à?)
I can't wrap my head around this math problem. (Không thể hiểu nổi bài toán này.)

phrases.phrase: Cost an arm and a leg
phrases.example: This designer bag costs an arm and a leg. (Chiếc túi này đắt cắt cổ.)

phrases.definition: Complain about something that cannot be fixed.
phrases.example: It's broken, no use crying over spilled milk. (Than vãn chuyện đã rồi cũng vô ích.)

phrases.definition: An obvious problem that everyone ignores.
phrases.example: Let's address the elephant in the room: the budget cuts. (Hãy nói về vấn đề nhạy cảm: cắt giảm ngân sách.)
My grandpa is 80 but fit as a fiddle. (Ông tôi rất khỏe mạnh.)
She gave me the cold shoulder at the party. (Cô ấy phớt lờ tôi.)
Looking for that old file was a wild goose chase. (Tìm kiếm vô ích.)

phrases.definition: Sometimes it's better not to know.
phrases.example: I didn't know they argued; ignorance is bliss. (Không biết lại tốt hơn.)
We will leave no stone unturned to find the bug. (Sẽ thử mọi cách có thể.)

phrases.phrase: Let the cat out of the bag
phrases.example: Who let the cat out of the bag about the merger? (Ai đã tiết lộ bí mật sáp nhập?)
I eat fast food once in a blue moon. (Tôi rất hiếm khi ăn đồ ăn nhanh.)

phrases.definition: Take credit or attention from someone else.
phrases.example: He stole my thunder by announcing his news first. (Anh ta đã cướp sự chú ý của tôi.)

phrases.phrase: Take with a grain of salt
phrases.definition: Not take something too seriously or literally.
phrases.example: Take his promises with a grain of salt. (Nghe lời hứa của anh ta để tham khảo thôi.)
We stayed friends through thick and thin. (Sát cánh qua mọi thăng trầm.)
Time flies when you are having fun. (Thời gian trôi nhanh quá.)

phrases.definition: Survive a difficult or dangerous situation.
phrases.example: The company will weather the storm and recover. (Sẽ vượt qua giông bão.)
Bring me up to speed on the latest changes. (Cập nhật cho tôi tiến độ mới nhất.)

phrases.phrase: Off the top of my head
phrases.example: Off the top of my head, it costs $50. (Nhớ mang máng thì khoảng 50 đô.)
We get most clients by word of mouth. (Chủ yếu qua truyền miệng.)

phrases.phrase: In the blink of an eye
phrases.example: The car disappeared in the blink of an eye. (Biến mất trong nháy mắt.)
He called me out of the blue yesterday. (Gọi bất thình lình.)
Your new boss is a real piece of work. (Sếp mới đúng là người khó xơi.)
Despite his wealth, he is very down to earth. (Rất thực tế và bình dị.)

phrases.definition: To relax and accept a situation as it happens.
phrases.example: I don't have a plan, I'll just go with the flow. (Cứ để mọi chuyện tự nhiên.)
Hold your horses, we aren't ready to leave yet. (Bình tĩnh, chưa đi được đâu.)

phrases.phrase: Bite off more than you can chew
phrases.definition: Take on a task that is way too big.
phrases.example: I bit off more than I could chew with this project. (Ôm đồm quá nhiều việc.)

phrases.definition: Relieve tension in a new situation.
phrases.example: A joke is a good way to break the ice. (Phá vỡ bầu không khí ngại ngùng.)

phrases.phrase: Cross that bridge when you come to it
phrases.definition: Deal with a problem only when it arises.
phrases.example: Don't worry about next year, cross that bridge when you come to it. (Chuyện đâu còn có đó.)

phrases.definition: Decide how to act as a situation develops.
phrases.example: We don't have a schedule, let's play it by ear. (Tùy cơ ứng biến.)

phrases.definition: Urging someone to say what they are hesitating about.
phrases.example: Just spit it out! What did he say? (Nói toẹt ra đi!)

phrases.definition: Politely decline but promise to do it later.
phrases.example: I'm busy today, can I take a rain check? (Hẹn dịp khác nhé?)

phrases.definition: To return to a topic at a later time.
phrases.example: Let's circle back to the budget issue later. (Hãy quay lại vấn đề ngân sách sau.)

phrases.definition: Willing to listen to new ideas.
phrases.example: I'm open to suggestions if you have a better way. (Rất sẵn lòng lắng nghe ý kiến.)
I see your point, but we need to consider time. (Tôi hiểu ý bạn.)
I think we can find some common ground. (Có thể tìm được điểm chung.)

phrases.definition: Expressing an opposing opinion to test an argument.
phrases.example: To play devil's advocate, what if the market drops? (Để phản biện một chút thì sao?)

phrases.definition: Start focusing on the actual work.
phrases.example: Let's get down to business. (Bắt tay vào việc chính thôi.)

phrases.definition: A formal way to suggest an idea.
phrases.example: I'd like to propose a new strategy. (Tôi muốn đề xuất một chiến lược.)

phrases.definition: Accept that you won't reach a consensus.
phrases.example: Let's just agree to disagree. (Tạm gác lại bất đồng nhé.)
I'm confident that this project will succeed. (Tôi tin chắc rằng.)
Please keep me in the loop on updates. (Hãy cập nhật thông tin cho tôi.)
We've been at this for hours, let's call it a day. (Hôm nay nghỉ thôi.)

phrases.definition: To be in charge of an action.
phrases.example: Why don't you take the lead on the presentation? (Bạn dẫn dắt bài thuyết trình nhé?)
We need to think outside the box. (Cần suy nghĩ sáng tạo.)
I'll get you up to speed on what we discussed. (Cập nhật những gì đã thảo luận.)
Keep an eye on the development costs. (Theo dõi sát chi phí.)
Could you walk me through your proposal? (Giải thích chi tiết từng bước nhé?)
The bottom line is we need to cut costs. (Vấn đề cốt lõi là phải giảm chi phí.)
Let's ensure we're all on the same page. (Đảm bảo tất cả hiểu giống nhau.)
Let's touch base early next week. (Liên lạc lại vào đầu tuần sau nhé.)
This meeting was truly worthwhile. (Cuộc họp thực sự có giá trị.)
Our plan failed, back to the drawing board. (Làm lại từ đầu thôi.)
We hit a minor snag with the shipment. (Gặp chút trở ngại nhỏ.)

phrases.definition: A result good for both sides.
phrases.example: This is a win-win situation. (Đôi bên cùng có lợi.)

phrases.definition: Get to the main point directly.
phrases.example: Let's cut to the chase—can we meet the deadline? (Đi thẳng vào vấn đề đi.)
Could we go over the contract terms? (Xem lại các điều khoản nhé?)
What skills do you bring to the table? (Bạn đóng góp được gì?)
The date is still up in the air. (Vẫn chưa được quyết định.)
We have a few details to iron out. (Còn vài chi tiết cần giải quyết.)
We need to stay on track with the schedule. (Đảm bảo đúng tiến độ.)
I'd like to bring up the issue of overtime. (Đưa vấn đề ra thảo luận.)
I had to make a judgment call. (Tự đưa ra quyết định dựa trên kinh nghiệm.)
We don't always see eye to eye. (Không phải lúc nào cũng đồng quan điểm.)
Let’s chat to clear the air. (Làm rõ mọi chuyện và xóa căng thẳng.)
We must take into account the feedback. (Phải cân nhắc các phản hồi.)
Please stick to the point. (Tập trung vào chủ đề chính.)
Fair enough, just try to be on time. (Nghe hợp lý đấy.)

phrases.definition: Get someone's opinion on an idea.
phrases.example: I'll run this idea by my boss. (Hỏi ý kiến sếp về ý tưởng này.)
Let's get the ball rolling today. (Bắt đầu triển khai ngay hôm nay.)

phrases.definition: Considering a long period into the future.
phrases.example: This will be beneficial in the long run. (Có lợi về lâu dài.)
Let's meet halfway on the price. (Nhượng bộ nhau ở mức giữa đi.)
Let's table the discussion until we have more data. (Gác lại cuộc thảo luận này đã.)

phrases.definition: Discuss outside of the current larger meeting.
phrases.example: That's a specific issue, let's take it offline. (Hãy thảo luận riêng vấn đề này sau.)

phrases.definition: A thorough and detailed exploration of a topic.
phrases.example: We need to do a deep dive into the Q3 metrics. (Cần phân tích chuyên sâu số liệu Q3.)

phrases.definition: A specific task assigned to a person during a meeting.
phrases.example: John, your action item is to email the client. (John, nhiệm vụ của bạn là gửi email.)

phrases.definition: The capacity or time someone has to do work.
phrases.example: I don't have the bandwidth to take on a new project. (Tôi không đủ thời gian/sức lực để nhận thêm việc.)
Software design is our company's core competency. (Năng lực cốt lõi của công ty.)

phrases.definition: Make a noticeable difference or impact.
phrases.example: This new ad campaign will really move the needle. (Sẽ tạo ra tác động rõ rệt.)
AI is causing a paradigm shift in our industry. (Sự thay đổi mô hình mang tính bước ngoặt.)

phrases.definition: Extend the limits of what is possible.
phrases.example: We need to push the envelope with this new design. (Vượt qua những giới hạn cũ.)

phrases.definition: Able to grow and manage increased demand.
phrases.example: Is this database architecture truly scalable? (Có khả năng mở rộng không?)
There's great synergy between our two teams. (Sự phối hợp cộng hưởng tuyệt vời.)

phrases.definition: Progress or momentum of an idea/product.
phrases.example: Our new app is finally gaining traction in Asia. (Đang dần có được sức hút/sự chú ý.)
Financial modeling is right in my wheelhouse. (Đúng chuyên môn/sở trường của tôi.)

phrases.definition: A very short, persuasive summary of an idea.
phrases.example: Give me your 30-second elevator pitch. (Bài thuyết trình ngắn gọn trong 30 giây.)

phrases.definition: An event/idea that significantly alters the current situation.
phrases.example: This technology is a total game changer. (Nhân tố thay đổi cục diện.)

phrases.definition: Tasks or goals that are easily achievable.
phrases.example: Let's focus on the low-hanging fruit first to get quick wins. (Mục tiêu dễ đạt được nhất.)

phrases.definition: Undertake an impossible or overly broad task.
phrases.example: Don't try to boil the ocean; just fix the main bug. (Đừng làm việc bao đồng/bất khả thi.)

phrases.definition: Unfairly changing the rules or targets during a process.
phrases.example: It's hard to succeed when management keeps moving the goalposts. (Thay đổi mục tiêu liên tục.)

phrases.definition: Test an idea to see the reaction.
phrases.example: Let's run this concept up the flagpole and see who salutes. (Thử nghiệm ý tưởng xem phản hồi ra sao.)

phrases.definition: Hold onto an idea to discuss it later.
phrases.example: Let's put a pin in that topic for next week's meeting. (Ghim vấn đề đó lại để bàn sau.)

phrases.definition: A futile attempt to control a disorganized group.
phrases.example: Managing this creative team is like herding cats. (Khó như quản lý một bầy mèo.)
We are getting too deep in the weeds on this minor issue. (Sa đà quá sâu vào tiểu tiết.)
I will be out of pocket this weekend. (Tôi sẽ không thể liên lạc được/vắng mặt.)

phrases.definition: Fundamentally change the direction of a business strategy.
phrases.example: The startup had to pivot when their first product failed. (Chuyển hướng chiến lược.)

phrases.definition: To analyze or examine something in detail.
phrases.example: Let's unpack the results of the survey. (Hãy mổ xẻ/phân tích chi tiết.)

phrases.definition: An extra feature that gives something greater value.
phrases.example: What is the specific value-add of your consulting service? (Giá trị gia tăng.)

phrases.definition: How a situation looks to the public or observers.
phrases.example: We can't fire him now; the optics would be terrible. (Góc nhìn/dư luận.)

phrases.definition: The most effective and accepted way of doing something.
phrases.example: We should adopt industry best practices for cybersecurity. (Quy trình chuẩn mực nhất.)

phrases.definition: Look at something in more detail.
phrases.example: Let's drill down into the demographic data. (Đi sâu vào chi tiết.)

phrases.definition: Able to be done or acted on.
phrases.example: We need actionable insights from this report, not just theories. (Có thể thực thi được.)
We need complete alignment between sales and marketing. (Sự đồng bộ/liên kết.)
Have we reached a consensus on the budget? (Sự đồng thuận chung.)

phrases.definition: A person with an interest or concern in something.
phrases.example: We must update all external stakeholders. (Các bên liên quan.)

phrases.definition: A thing able to be provided, especially a product of a process.
phrases.example: The final report is the key deliverable for phase one. (Sản phẩm bàn giao.)
Reaching 1 million users is a huge milestone. (Cột mốc quan trọng.)

phrases.definition: A specific problem that customers are experiencing.
phrases.example: Our software solves a major pain point for accountants. (Điểm yếu/nỗi đau của khách hàng.)

phrases.definition: Any point of contact between a buyer and a seller.
phrases.example: We need to improve the customer experience at every touchpoint. (Điểm chạm khách hàng.)

phrases.definition: Standards of measurement by which efficiency is assessed.
phrases.example: What metrics are we using to track success? (Các chỉ số đo lường.)

phrases.definition: To be more advanced than competitors.
phrases.example: We need to innovate to get ahead of the curve. (Đổi mới để dẫn đầu xu thế.)
We won't throw in the towel just yet. (Sẽ không bỏ cuộc sớm thế đâu.)
Put that project on the back burner. (Tạm gác dự án sang một bên.)
We do this strictly by the book. (Làm đúng theo quy định.)
A new product is in the pipeline. (Đang phát triển sản phẩm mới.)
The CEO decided to take a backseat. (Bớt can thiệp vào việc hàng ngày.)
We got the green light to begin. (Được phép bắt đầu.)
Create a level playing field for competitors. (Tạo sân chơi bình đẳng.)
It's crunch time, stay focused. (Đến giai đoạn nước rút.)
Steer clear of that topic during negotiation. (Tránh đề cập đến chủ đề đó.)
It hasn't been smooth sailing, but we're progressing. (Không hề dễ dàng.)
I've been out of the loop lately. (Không nắm được thông tin.)
It was touch and go, but the deal was saved. (Tình thế vô cùng nguy hiểm.)
Don't jump the gun; wait for official data. (Đừng vội vàng quá.)
I draw the line at working weekends. (Vạch rõ giới hạn.)
The company has been in the red for months. (Thua lỗ liên tục.)
We have to see this project through. (Theo đuổi dự án đến cùng.)
Let’s put our heads together to solve this. (Cùng nhau thảo luận.)

phrases.definition: Challenge someone to prove a threat.
phrases.example: They threatened to quit, so I called their bluff. (Thách thức đối phương chứng minh.)

phrases.definition: Avoid making a final decision immediately.
phrases.example: Let's keep our options open before signing. (Cân nhắc các lựa chọn khác.)
Our goal is to corner the market. (Thống lĩnh thị trường.)
Due to lower sales, we need to tighten our belts. (Thắt chặt chi tiêu.)
I need to buy some time to review documents. (Kéo dài thời gian.)
The team went the extra mile to finish. (Cực kỳ nỗ lực.)
It’s vital to keep a level head during a crisis. (Giữ cái đầu lạnh.)
The competitor upped the ante by lowering prices. (Tăng sức ép/cược.)
Let's get down to brass tacks. (Đi thẳng vào vấn đề chính.)
They pressured me, but I held my ground. (Giữ vững lập trường.)
Our profits will take a hit this quarter. (Lợi nhuận bị giảm sút.)
We worked all night to beat the clock. (Kịp thời hạn.)

phrases.definition: An issue that causes a negotiation to fail.
phrases.example: Lack of technical support is a dealbreaker for us. (Yếu tố khiến thỏa thuận đổ vỡ.)

phrases.definition: Aggressive or ruthless behavior in business.
phrases.example: They are playing hardball on the pricing terms. (Chơi rắn/ép giá tàn nhẫn.)
They tried to lowball us on the initial offer. (Đưa ra mức giá thấp bất hợp lý.)

phrases.definition: Understand the emotions and thoughts of the people present.
phrases.example: You need to read the room before pitching a risky idea. (Nắm bắt tâm lý đám đông/đối tác.)

phrases.definition: Add an extra incentive to an offer.
phrases.example: If you order 1000 units, I'll sweeten the deal with free shipping. (Đưa ra thêm lợi ích hấp dẫn.)

phrases.definition: The position of having power or control.
phrases.example: Having exclusive patents gives us the upper hand. (Chiếm ưu thế/nắm đằng chuôi.)

phrases.definition: Power to influence people and get the results you want.
phrases.example: We have immense leverage in this negotiation. (Lợi thế/đòn bẩy đàm phán.)

phrases.definition: To be the person making all the important decisions.
phrases.example: When it comes to marketing, Sarah calls the shots. (Là người có quyền quyết định cuối cùng.)

phrases.definition: Forced to begin from the very start again.
phrases.example: The prototype failed, so it's back to square one. (Trở lại vạch xuất phát.)

phrases.definition: Start to be successful or function.
phrases.example: It took years for the startup to get off the ground. (Bắt đầu cất cánh/thành công.)

phrases.definition: Get an initial opportunity in a company/market.
phrases.example: This internship is a great way to get your foot in the door. (Bước chân vào cửa/cơ hội ban đầu.)

phrases.definition: Take the average of two proposed amounts.
phrases.example: You want $100, I offer $80; let's split the difference at $90. (Cưa đôi khoảng cách/chia đều phần chênh lệch.)
Always read the terms and conditions carefully. (Điều khoản và điều kiện.)
Our new AI feature is the ace up our sleeve. (Bảo bối bí mật/quân bài tẩy.)

phrases.definition: Something used to gain an advantage in a negotiation.
phrases.example: We can use the delivery date as a bargaining chip. (Vật mặc cả/quân cờ đàm phán.)

phrases.definition: Wait patiently for a good opportunity.
phrases.example: We are biding our time until the competitor goes bankrupt. (Kiên nhẫn chờ thời cơ.)
The company caved in to the union's demands. (Chịu thua/nhượng bộ hoàn toàn.)
We finally closed the deal after three months of talks. (Chốt hợp đồng thành công.)

phrases.definition: Expect a lot in exchange for what you pay.
phrases.example: She drives a hard bargain, but she is fair. (Mặc cả gay gắt/đàm phán rất giỏi.)

phrases.definition: Compel someone to act before they want to.
phrases.example: The leak to the press forced the CEO's hand. (Ép ai đó phải hành động/lật bài ngửa.)

phrases.definition: To be in a strong position with all the advantages.
phrases.example: In this monopoly, the supplier holds all the cards. (Nắm toàn quyền chủ động.)

phrases.definition: Give up something in order to reach an agreement.
phrases.example: Both sides must make concessions to succeed. (Đưa ra sự nhượng bộ.)

phrases.definition: Agree to the conditions set by someone.
phrases.example: We cannot meet your terms regarding the payment schedule. (Đáp ứng các điều khoản.)
We must stand firm on the security requirements. (Giữ vững lập trường, không khoan nhượng.)
This is our final offer, take it or leave it. (Nhận hoặc bỏ đi, không mặc cả thêm.)
He talked the investors into funding the project. (Thuyết phục ai đó làm gì.)

phrases.definition: Leave a negotiation without a deal.
phrases.example: Be prepared to walk away if the price is too high. (Sẵn sàng bỏ đi nếu không thỏa đáng.)

phrases.definition: A situation where one person's gain is another's loss.
phrases.example: Business isn't always a zero-sum game. (Trò chơi có tổng bằng không/được mất rõ ràng.)

phrases.definition: An offer made in response to another's offer.
phrases.example: They rejected $50k and made a counter-offer of $60k. (Lời đề nghị ngược lại/đáp trả.)

phrases.definition: A situation where no progress can be made.
phrases.example: The peace talks have reached a deadlock. (Tình trạng bế tắc.)

phrases.definition: Disputing or bargaining persistently over a price.
phrases.example: I spent an hour haggling over the price of the car. (Cò kè mặc cả.)
I have to call out the lack of communication. (Chỉ rõ sự thiếu tương tác.)
We need everyone on board to make this work. (Cùng đồng lòng tham gia.)
It's hard to get management buy-in for this. (Sự chấp thuận từ quản lý.)
Nobody likes a boss who tries to micromanage. (Quản lý quá chi li.)
You need to learn how to delegate to avoid burnout. (Ủy quyền giao việc.)
My goal is to empower my team. (Trao quyền cho nhân viên.)
Soft skills are just as important as tech skills. (Kỹ năng mềm.)
Coding is a core hard skill here. (Kỹ năng cứng/chuyên môn.)
We will discuss your growth during the performance review. (Đánh giá năng lực.)
She worked hard to climb the corporate ladder. (Thăng tiến sự nghiệp.)
Team members must take ownership of tasks. (Chủ động nhận trách nhiệm.)
Let's have a brainstorming session. (Thảo luận tìm ý tưởng.)

phrases.definition: Division of time working vs personal.
phrases.example: Employees prioritize work-life balance. (Cân bằng công việc-cuộc sống.)
This is a high-stakes negotiation. (Tình huống rủi ro/quan trọng cao.)
The manager always sets the bar high. (Đặt tiêu chuẩn cao.)
We need to bridge the gap between teams. (Thu hẹp khoảng cách.)
We missed the target, time to face the music. (Đối mặt với hậu quả.)
Please see to it that the report is finished. (Đảm bảo việc được hoàn thành.)
Great leaders bring out the best in their team. (Khơi gợi tiềm năng tốt nhất.)
You should lead by example. (Làm gương cho người khác.)
We need to streamline our hiring process. (Đơn giản hóa/tối ưu hóa quy trình.)

phrases.definition: Make the best use of a resource.
phrases.example: We optimized the website for faster loading. (Tối ưu hóa.)

phrases.definition: Integrate a new employee into an organization.
phrases.example: HR will onboard the new engineers next week. (Đào tạo hội nhập nhân viên mới.)
We formed a cross-functional team to tackle the issue. (Liên phòng ban/đa chức năng.)

phrases.definition: Systems or departments that operate in isolation.
phrases.example: Information silos are destroying our company's efficiency. (Sự cô lập giữa các phòng ban.)

phrases.definition: A point of congestion in a system.
phrases.example: The legal review is the main bottleneck right now. (Nút thắt cổ chai/điểm gây ách tắc.)

phrases.definition: Time taken to complete a process.
phrases.example: We need to reduce the turnaround time for customer replies. (Thời gian xử lý/hoàn thành.)
The software failed the QA testing phase. (Đảm bảo chất lượng.)
We will deploy the new servers at midnight. (Triển khai/đưa vào hoạt động.)

phrases.definition: Officially launch or introduce a new product.
phrases.example: The company plans to roll out the new app in May. (Ra mắt trên diện rộng.)

phrases.definition: Standard against which things may be compared.
phrases.example: Use last year's sales as a benchmark. (Tiêu chuẩn so sánh/cột mốc.)

phrases.definition: The maximum amount something can produce.
phrases.example: Our factory is operating at maximum capacity. (Công suất/năng lực tối đa.)
Sales growth is our primary KPI this quarter. (Chỉ số đánh giá hiệu quả công việc chính.)

phrases.definition: Detailed coordination of a complex operation.
phrases.example: The logistics of moving the office will be a nightmare. (Hậu cần/vận hành chi tiết.)

phrases.definition: Sequence of processes making and distributing a product.
phrases.example: The global supply chain was disrupted by the storm. (Chuỗi cung ứng.)

phrases.definition: Sequence of industrial, administrative, or other processes.
phrases.example: This software will automate our entire approval workflow. (Quy trình/luồng công việc.)

phrases.definition: Ability to move and adapt quickly.
phrases.example: Agility is crucial for startups competing with giants. (Sự linh hoạt/nhanh nhạy.)

phrases.definition: Excessive bureaucracy or adherence to rules.
phrases.example: There is too much red tape involved in getting a visa. (Thủ tục rườm rà/quan liêu.)
We need to fast-track this project to meet the deadline. (Đẩy nhanh tiến độ/đi đường tắt.)

phrases.definition: Official approval to end or begin something.
phrases.example: We are waiting for the CEO's sign-off on the budget. (Sự phê duyệt chính thức.)

phrases.definition: Increase the level or amount of something sharply.
phrases.example: We need to ramp up production for the holiday season. (Tăng cường/đẩy mạnh đột ngột.)

phrases.definition: Gradually stop using or producing something.
phrases.example: We will phase out the old software over six months. (Loại bỏ dần dần.)

phrases.definition: Take apart to examine and repair thoroughly.
phrases.example: The entire HR system needs a complete overhaul. (Đại tu/cải tổ toàn diện.)

phrases.definition: Time between the initiation and completion of a process.
phrases.example: The lead time for manufacturing this part is 3 weeks. (Thời gian chờ từ lúc đặt hàng đến lúc giao.)

phrases.definition: Inventory strategy reducing waste and response times.
phrases.example: We use just-in-time manufacturing to save warehouse space. (Sản xuất vừa đúng lúc.)
We have a freeze on headcount increases this year. (Tổng số nhân sự.)

phrases.definition: The time when a system becomes operational.
phrases.example: The website go-live is scheduled for tomorrow at 8 AM. (Thời điểm hệ thống chính thức chạy.)

phrases.definition: Time when a machine or system is out of action.
phrases.example: Server downtime cost us thousands of dollars. (Thời gian chết/hệ thống ngừng hoạt động.)
Always have a contingency plan in case the supplier fails. (Kế hoạch dự phòng.)

phrases.definition: Approaches to prepare and support individuals through change.
phrases.example: Poor change management led to employee resistance. (Quản trị sự thay đổi.)

phrases.definition: Rate at which a company spends its capital.
phrases.example: Our startup's burn rate is $50,000 per month. (Tốc độ đốt tiền/tiêu thụ vốn.)
We hired extra staff to clear the backlog of orders. (Khối lượng công việc tồn đọng.)

phrases.definition: Gradual reduction of workforce by employees leaving.
phrases.example: High employee attrition is a sign of bad management. (Tỷ lệ nhân viên nghỉ việc tự nhiên.)

phrases.definition: Action of distributing resources or duties.
phrases.example: Proper resource allocation is key to project success. (Sự phân bổ tài nguyên/ngân sách.)

phrases.definition: Agile framework for managing knowledge work.
phrases.example: We have a 15-minute daily scrum meeting. (Khung làm việc Agile quản lý dự án.)

phrases.definition: A set period to complete specific tasks.
phrases.example: Our dev team works in two-week sprints. (Giai đoạn chạy nước rút trong dự án.)

phrases.definition: A short daily meeting to coordinate the team.
phrases.example: Don't be late for the morning stand-up. (Cuộc họp đứng/giao ban nhanh.)

phrases.definition: Obtaining goods or a service from an outside supplier.
phrases.example: Outsourcing IT support saved us a lot of money. (Thuê ngoài dịch vụ.)

phrases.definition: Action of obtaining equipment, materials, or services.
phrases.example: The procurement department handles purchasing raw materials. (Hoạt động thu mua/cung ứng.)

phrases.definition: A formal phrase indicating a file is connected.
phrases.example: Attached please find the contract for your review. (Vui lòng xem tài liệu đính kèm.)

phrases.definition: A formal way to notify the reader.
phrases.example: Please be advised that the office is closed. (Xin thông báo rằng.)

phrases.definition: According to what was previously spoken about.
phrases.example: As per our discussion, I updated the timeline. (Theo như thảo luận của chúng ta.)
Further to our conversation, here is the data. (Tiếp nối cuộc trò chuyện.)

phrases.phrase: Look forward to hearing from you
phrases.definition: Polite closing waiting for a reply.
phrases.example: I look forward to hearing from you soon. (Mong sớm nhận được phản hồi.)

phrases.definition: Formal phrase stating papers are enclosed.
phrases.example: Please find enclosed the invoice. (Vui lòng xem tài liệu gửi kèm.)
In light of recent changes, we must adjust. (Xét đến tình hình hiện tại.)
The budget is pending approval. (Đang chờ phê duyệt.)
Please sign at your earliest convenience. (Sớm nhất có thể khi bạn rảnh.)
Please kindly acknowledge receipt. (Vui lòng xác nhận đã nhận.)

phrases.definition: Introduce the topic of an email.
phrases.example: With reference to your inquiry, here are details. (Liên quan đến yêu cầu của bạn.)
Due to unforeseen circumstances, it is canceled. (Do tình huống bất khả kháng.)

phrases.definition: Polite way to thank for obeying rules.
phrases.example: Thank you for your cooperation in this matter. (Cảm ơn sự hợp tác.)
FYI, the deadline has been extended. (Thông tin cho bạn nắm rõ.)

phrases.definition: Formal way to ask for info.
phrases.example: I would like to inquire about my order. (Tôi muốn hỏi thăm về.)
I will keep you posted on any changes. (Sẽ cập nhật thông tin liên tục.)
I am out of office and will reply Monday. (Vắng mặt tại văn phòng.)
I am writing on behalf of our CEO. (Đại diện cho.)
Should you have any questions, let us know. (Nếu bạn có thắc mắc.)
Best regards, John. (Trân trọng.)
We try to go above and beyond for clients. (Vượt lên trên sự mong đợi.)
I hear you, and I understand your frustration. (Tôi thấu hiểu cảm giác của bạn.)
Could you bear with me for a moment? (Vui lòng chờ tôi một chút.)
We’d like to offer a discount to make it up to you. (Đền bù/Bù đắp cho bạn.)
As a valued customer, your feedback is vital. (Khách hàng đáng quý.)
We will get to the bottom of this glitch. (Tìm ra nguyên nhân gốc rễ.)
Apologies for any inconvenience caused. (Sự bất tiện/phiền toái đã gây ra.)
We updated it to better meet your requirements. (Đáp ứng yêu cầu.)
Rest assured, our engineers are fixing it. (Hãy cứ yên tâm.)
I will personally look into this error. (Đích thân xem xét/điều tra.)

phrases.definition: Returning to a previous topic in an email.
phrases.example: Circling back on my previous email regarding the contract. (Quay lại vấn đề ở email trước.)

phrases.definition: Checking on the status of a previous request.
phrases.example: I'm following up on the invoice sent last week. (Hỏi thăm tiến độ/theo dõi sát.)

phrases.definition: Referring to a previous email's content.
phrases.example: Per our last email, the deadline is Friday. (Theo như email trước của chúng ta.)

phrases.definition: Looking to the future or next steps.
phrases.example: Moving forward, please send all requests to IT. (Kể từ nay trở đi/Hướng tới tương lai.)

phrases.definition: Have a quick phone or video conversation.
phrases.example: Let's jump on a quick call to sort this out. (Gọi điện nhanh để giải quyết.)
Feel free to reach out if you need assistance. (Chủ động liên hệ.)

phrases.definition: Deal with the minor remaining parts of a task.
phrases.example: I just need to tie up a few loose ends before deploying. (Hoàn tất những chi tiết cuối cùng.)
Warm regards, Sarah Manager. (Trân trọng và thân mến.)

phrases.definition: Formal greeting when the recipient is unknown.
phrases.example: To whom it may concern, I am applying for... (Gửi tới những ai có liên quan.)
Thank you for your prompt response. (Phản hồi nhanh chóng.)
We appreciate your patience while we fix the server. (Cảm ơn vì đã kiên nhẫn chờ đợi.)

phrases.definition: Saying sorry for being late to reply.
phrases.example: Apologies for the delay in getting back to you. (Xin lỗi vì sự chậm trễ.)

phrases.definition: Include someone in an email chain.
phrases.example: I'm going to loop in David from Accounting. (Đưa ai đó vào vòng lặp trao đổi email.)
Please CC me on all correspondence with the client. (Đồng kính gửi/Gửi ẩn danh.)

phrases.definition: Briefly mention or discuss a topic.
phrases.example: I wanted to touch upon the marketing budget. (Đề cập lướt qua/nhắc đến.)
Could you clarify what you mean by 'ASAP'? (Làm rõ/giải thích rõ ràng.)
Can we expedite the shipping process? (Thúc đẩy/đẩy nhanh tiến độ.)
Please review this document at your earliest convenience. (Vui lòng xem xét sớm nhất có thể.)

phrases.definition: Included inside an envelope or physical package.
phrases.example: Please find enclosed the signed documents. (Được đính kèm trong thư.)

phrases.phrase: Let me know if you have any questions
phrases.example: Let me know if you have any questions regarding the quote. (Cho tôi biết nếu bạn có câu hỏi.)

phrases.definition: Directing attention to an email attachment.
phrases.example: Please find attached the Q3 financial report. (Vui lòng xem file đính kèm.)

phrases.definition: Say something again for clarity or emphasis.
phrases.example: I want to reiterate the importance of this deadline. (Nhấn mạnh lại/nhắc lại.)
I have a question pertaining to your recent invoice. (Liên quan đến.)

phrases.definition: In a way that is appropriate to the circumstances.
phrases.example: The rules have changed, please adjust accordingly. (Phù hợp với điều đó/Tương ứng.)
I enclose herewith a copy of the policy. (Kèm theo thư này.)

phrases.definition: Answering a specific query or action.
phrases.example: I am writing in response to your advertisement. (Để phản hồi cho.)

phrases.definition: Bringing attention to a specific fact.
phrases.example: Please note that the office closes at 4 PM on Fridays. (Vui lòng lưu ý rằng.)

phrases.definition: A polite way of asking someone to do something.
phrases.example: Kindly forward this email to your manager. (Vui lòng/xin vui lòng.)
We need these files ASAP. (Càng sớm càng tốt.)

phrases.definition: End of Day / Close of Business.
phrases.example: Please send the draft by EOD tomorrow. (Cuối ngày làm việc.)
I will be OOO until next Tuesday. (Vắng mặt khỏi văn phòng.)

phrases.definition: Please reply (French: Répondez s'il vous plaît).
phrases.example: Please RSVP by November 15th for the event. (Vui lòng phản hồi xác nhận.)
Here is the final file. NRN. (Không cần phản hồi đâu.)

phrases.definition: To Be Determined / To Be Announced.
phrases.example: The exact venue is TBD. (Sẽ được quyết định/thông báo sau.)
